column1: # The grammar.xml each FieldWorks witness was authored against: fixture id, then the SHA-256 of grammar.xml (text,
# line endings normalised, as the manifest hashes it). Tab-separated. scripts/check_fwdata.py fails when a hash no
# longer matches, because the witness may then project to a different grammar. Never update a hash to make the check
# pass after editing grammar.xml: regenerate the witness first. A witness not listed here must be listed in
# fieldworks-stale-witnesses.tsv. The hash lives here, not in phonology-mutations.yaml, because that file's key
# vocabulary is v1 and sillsdev/machine's gate rejects any other key.
